rawContent: If #BlackLivesMatter to Mark Zuckerberg, then he should ensure that Black users are not targeted with misinformation, harassment and censorship on his platform and stop cozying up to anti-Black forces. Until then, his company will be remembered as an enabler of white supremacy.

Today, Zuckerberg will try to push back against critics claiming that Facebook “allowed” movements like #BlackLivesMatter to spread and build power. If he wants to use our movement to claim support for Black communities, then Black lives have to matter more than his bottom line.
